about.metaDescription.message: About Embedbits: reusable, well-documented building blocks for maintainable STM32 development.

about.intro.message: Embedbits is a collection of embedded software projects, tools and articles focused on maintainable STM32 development. It started as a personal answer to a familiar problem: every project ends up with its own build scripts, its own drivers and its own way of doing things. Embedbits tries to turn that into reusable, well-documented building blocks.

about.who.text.message: I'm Mr.Nobody, an embedded software engineer with a background in the automotive industry. The coding style, the state machine template and many of the architecture ideas here come from real projects, then simplified and published as open source. The licence of each project is stated in its repository.

about.find.projects.text.message: EmBi_Platform, the BSP (RAL and MCAL) and Artifacts, the build tools fetched automatically.

about.find.docs.text.message: the READMEs of all repositories in one place, including which STM32 families each module supports.

about.find.articles.text.message: notes about software architecture, state machines and embedded C.

about.principles.2.message: One module, one responsibility, one interface.

about.principles.3.message: Reproducible builds: the same project builds the same way on every machine.

about.principles.4.message: If it can be tested, it should be.

contact.intro.message: Get in touch regarding projects, collaboration, commercial licensing or embedded software development.

contact.contributions.message: Contributions are welcome. Please open a pull request in the relevant repository.

projects.platform.description.message: Setup scripts, CMake helpers, STM32CubeIDE templates and updater that tie a project together.

projects.bsp.description.message: Board Support Package with one branch per STM32 family: linker, startup, RAL and MCAL.

projects.ral.description.message: Register abstraction layer around CMSIS and STM32 LL for a unified low-level interface.

projects.mcal.description.message: Peripheral drivers with a consistent API: GPIO, USART, I2C, ADC, DMA, NVIC, TIM and more.

projects.artifacts.description.message: Versioned build tools such as GCC, Ninja, Doxygen, Unity, CMock and Renode, fetched automatically.

home.metaDescription.message: Embedded software engineering, projects, documentation and articles.

home.description.message: Reusable embedded software projects, engineering documentation and practical articles covering architecture, STM32, tooling, testing and development infrastructure.

home.motto1.message: Always write your code, as if the guy, who ends up maintaining your code,

home.motto2.message: will be a violent psychopath who knows where you live.

home.feature1.text.message: Architecture, configuration and practical guides for embedded software projects.

home.feature2.text.message: Practical notes about embedded C, STM32, software architecture, build systems and development tools.

home.feature3.text.message: Focused on maintainable software, reproducible builds, testing and reusable infrastructure.

projects.intro.message: Reusable software components and development infrastructure for embedded systems.
